thesis: The report began closer observation of XLV on relative strength and a price above its 50-session average, without proposing a purchase.
counterevidence: A prior price rally may already be reflected, while pharmaceutical, insurance and equipment fundamentals and regulation differ.
invalidation: Persistent deterioration relative to SPY, a renewed break below the 50-session average, or worsening major company earnings.
revisit_trigger: Reassess 5/10/20 US sessions later with sector-wide results, ETF structure and valuation.
